narration: There's a credit on your tax return worth up to $7,830. About five million Americans who qualify never collect it. The IRS never sends you a reminder.
visual: Dark background. Green IRS envelope with dollar sign springs in from above. '$7,830 — UNCLAIMED' text appears below. Bold white title: 'THE IRS CREDIT NOBODY CLAIMS'.

narration: It's called the Earned Income Credit. Unlike a deduction, it's refundable — meaning you get a direct deposit even if you owe zero in taxes. The IRS literally sends you money.
visual: Light background. IRS building icon on left, green arrow grows across to person silhouette on right with dollar signs floating above. 'DIRECT DEPOSIT — EVEN WITH ZERO TAX OWED' text.

narration: Here's who qualifies. Single with no kids — under $18,600 a year. One child — under $49,000. Two kids — under $55,800. Gig workers and part-timers count too.
visual: Dark background. Four rows for NO KIDS, 1 CHILD, 2 CHILDREN, 3+ CHILDREN with income limit labels. Green bars animate in one by one.

narration: The amounts are serious money. No kids: $632. One child: $3,995. Two kids: $6,604. Three or more kids: $7,830 deposited directly into your account.
visual: Light background. Four horizontal bars grow proportionally: NO KIDS $632, 1 CHILD $3,995, 2 KIDS $6,604, 3+ KIDS $7,830. Amounts appear beside each bar.

narration: Why do five million eligible workers miss it? It's buried in tax software. Gig workers falsely think they can't qualify. And the IRS has no obligation to tell you what you're leaving behind.
visual: Dark background. '5M' in red pops in large. Three numbered reasons slide in: 1) Buried in tax software, 2) Gig workers think excluded, 3) IRS never sends a reminder.

narration: Search 'EITC Assistant' at IRS dot gov — it's free and takes two minutes. Missed it last year? Amended returns let you collect up to three years back. Follow for more hidden money.
visual: Light background. Smartphone SVG with 'EITC ASSISTANT' on screen and a green check circle. Three action steps appear. Bold green 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY SECRETS' CTA.
